title: His Teeth Are So Tiny He Cannot Bite an Apple | Extreme Teeth Grinding
description:
Joe hasn't been able to bite an apple for as long as he remembers. Even as a child his teeth were tiny compared to friends his age. He is used to being asked what's wrong with him because of his small teeth. Now, he is finally seeing a dentist to get the answers and help he need.
